1: #!/bin/bash
2: # autoflash.sh -- flash the BK7258 board without pressing RST by hand.
3: #
4: # How it works
5: # ------------
6: # bk_loader resets the board by pulsing DTR/RTS (CCommPort::do_reset_signal),
7: # but this board has no auto-reset circuit on those lines -- measured: pulsing
8: # either one produces zero bytes.  That is why a human has to press RST while
9: # bk_loader is looping on "Getting Bus...".
10: #
11: # The bootrom only answers the LinkCheck handshake for a short window after a
12: # reset.  Measured on this board: issuing "reboot" over the CP shell gives
13: # about 473 ms of silence (0.005 s -> 0.478 s) before firmware output starts,
14: # and the shell prompt is back at 1.04 s.  So the window is wide enough.
15: #
16: # bk_loader does not take TIOCEXCL on the tty, so a second process can write
17: # into the same port while bk_loader is looping.  Writing "reboot" there makes
18: # the running firmware reset itself -- exactly what pressing RST does, only
19: # scripted.  Verified: "Gotten Bus..." arrives ~0.5 s after the write.
20: #
21: # IMPORTANT: once the bus is taken, anything else written to the port would
22: # corrupt the protocol, so the reboot loop stops the moment "Gotten Bus"
23: # appears in the log.
24: 
25: set -u
26: 
27: ROOT=/home/mi/vela_competition
28: LOADER="$ROOT/bk_loader"
29: DEFAULT_IMAGE="$ROOT/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/all-app.bin"
30: RUNTIME_DIR="$ROOT/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/logs/runtime"
31: EXPECTED_SIZE=2646016
32: 
33: PORT=/dev/ttyUSB0
34: PORTNUM=0
35: 
36: # Two independent baud rates, do not conflate them.
37: #
38: # BAUD is only how fast bk_loader talks to the bootrom.  CONSOLE_BAUD is what
39: # the firmware's console runs at, which is fixed by the build (defconfig), so
40: # raising the flash speed must not change it.  Using one variable for both
41: # meant that after "-b 1500000" the post-flash screen opened at 1500000 and
42: # nothing typed into it worked.
43: BAUD=115200
44: CONSOLE_BAUD=115200
45: IMAGE="$DEFAULT_IMAGE"
46: LOG="$RUNTIME_DIR/autoflash.log"
47: REBOOT_TRIES=8
48: REBOOT_INTERVAL=1.5
49: 
50: # Overall timeout is derived from the image size, never hard-coded.
51: #
52: # A fixed 180 s was wrong and actively harmful: 2,646,016 bytes at 115200 baud
53: # is 10 bits per byte on the wire, i.e. ~230 s of writing alone, plus ~10 s of
54: # 64K erase.  timeout(1) killed a real flash at "Writing Flash ... 69%",
55: # leaving the board with an erased-but-incomplete image.  Computed below as
56: # transfer time x 2 plus 60 s of headroom.
57: OVERALL_TIMEOUT=0
58: ATTACH_SERIAL=0
59: SKIP_SIZE_CHECK=0
60: TEST_ONLY=0
61: 
62: usage() {
63:   cat <<'EOF'
64: 用法: autoflash.sh [选项]
65: 
66:   -i <file>    要烧录的镜像，默认 all-app.bin
67:   -p <port>    串口设备，默认 /dev/ttyUSB0
68:   -n <num>     bk_loader 的端口号，默认 0
69:   -b <baud>    烧录波特率，默认 115200（只影响下载速度）
70:   -B <baud>    控制台波特率，默认 115200（固件编译时定死的，一般别改）
71:   -s           跳过 all-app.bin 字节数校验
72:   -a           烧完自动挂上串口看日志
73:   -t           只测握手，不写 flash（用 read 代替 download）
74:   -h           显示本帮助
75: 
76: 说明: 不需要手按 RST。脚本会在 bk_loader 握手循环期间，从另一个进程往
77:       同一个串口写 reboot 来触发软复位。
78: EOF
79: }
80: 
81: while getopts "i:p:n:b:B:sath" opt; do
82:   case "$opt" in
83:     i) IMAGE="$OPTARG" ;;
84:     p) PORT="$OPTARG" ;;
85:     n) PORTNUM="$OPTARG" ;;
86:     b) BAUD="$OPTARG" ;;
87:     B) CONSOLE_BAUD="$OPTARG" ;;
88:     s) SKIP_SIZE_CHECK=1 ;;
89:     a) ATTACH_SERIAL=1 ;;
90:     t) TEST_ONLY=1 ;;
91:     h) usage; exit 0 ;;
92:     *) usage; exit 2 ;;
93:   esac
94: done
95: 
96: die() { echo "错误: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
97: 
98: # ---------------------------------------------------------------- 1. 前置检查
99: 
100: [ -x "$LOADER" ] || die "找不到 bk_loader: $LOADER"
101: [ -f "$IMAGE" ]  || die "找不到镜像: $IMAGE"
102: [ -c "$PORT" ]   || die "串口不存在: $PORT（板子插了吗？）"
103: mkdir -p "$RUNTIME_DIR" || die "无法创建运行记录目录: $RUNTIME_DIR"
104: 
105: SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$IMAGE")
106: SHA=$(sha256sum "$IMAGE" | cut -d' ' -f1)
107: 
108: # 10 bits on the wire per byte (8N1 plus start and stop).
109: XFER_SECS=$(( SIZE * 10 / BAUD ))
110: OVERALL_TIMEOUT=$(( XFER_SECS * 2 + 60 ))
111: 
112: echo "=== 待烧录镜像 ==="
113: echo "  路径   : $IMAGE"
114: echo "  字节数 : $SIZE"
115: echo "  SHA256 : $SHA"
116: echo "  串口   : $PORT"
117: echo "  烧录   : ${BAUD} baud，传输约 ${XFER_SECS}s，超时上限 ${OVERALL_TIMEOUT}s"
118: echo "  控制台 : ${CONSOLE_BAUD} baud（烧完会恢复成这个）"
119: 
120: if [ "$SKIP_SIZE_CHECK" -eq 0 ] && [ "$(basename "$IMAGE")" = "all-app.bin" ]; then
121:   if [ "$SIZE" -ne "$EXPECTED_SIZE" ]; then
122:     die "all-app.bin 应为 $EXPECTED_SIZE 字节，实际 $SIZE。打包可能不完整，用 -s 可跳过此检查"
123:   fi
124:   echo "  字节数校验通过"
125: fi
126: 
127: # ---------------------------------------------------------- 2. 释放串口占用
128: 
129: echo
130: echo "=== 释放串口 ==="
131: HOLDERS=$(fuser "$PORT" 2>/dev/null | tr -s ' ')
132: if [ -n "$HOLDERS" ]; then
133:   echo "  当前占用: $HOLDERS"
134: 
135:   pkill -f "picocom.*$PORT" >/dev/null 2>&1
136:   pkill -f "minicom.*$PORT" >/dev/null 2>&1
137: 
138:   sleep 0.5
139:   HOLDERS=$(fuser "$PORT" 2>/dev/null | tr -s ' ')
140:   if [ -n "$HOLDERS" ]; then
141:     die "串口仍被占用: $HOLDERS。手动处理后重试（参考 docs/端口冲突解决办法.md）"
142:   fi
143: fi
144: echo "  串口空闲"
145: 
146: # Console baud, not flash baud: the only thing written through this port
147: # before bk_loader takes over is the "reboot" command, and the firmware's
148: # console is listening at CONSOLE_BAUD.
149: stty -F "$PORT" "$CONSOLE_BAUD" cs8 -cstopb -parenb raw -echo -crtscts \
150:   || die "stty 配置失败"
151: 
152: # --------------------------------------------------- 3. 启动 bk_loader 并软复位
153: 
154: echo
155: : > "$LOG"
156: PIDFILE="$RUNTIME_DIR/autoflash.$$.pid"
157: : > "$PIDFILE"
158: 
159: # The in-loop reset works at any -b, and here is why it is safe to rely on:
160: # bk_loader opens the tty at 115200 no matter what -b says, handshakes there,
161: # and only switches to the requested rate once it owns the bus.  Measured from
162: # a real 1500000 run:
163: #
164: #   cmdline: ... bk_loader download -p 0 -b 1500000 ...
165: #   Current port : /dev/ttyUSB0 + BaudRate : 115200 connect success
166: #   Getting Bus... / Gotten Bus... / All Finished Successfully
167: #
168: # So while we are writing "reboot" the line is still at 115200 and the
169: # firmware console decodes it fine.  An earlier version of this script
170: # disabled the retry loop for BAUD != CONSOLE_BAUD on the theory that the port
171: # had already been switched up -- that was reasoning without measurement, and
172: # it broke a mechanism that worked.
173: 
174: if [ "$TEST_ONLY" -eq 1 ]; then
175:   echo "=== 只测握手，不写 flash ==="
176:   set -- read -p "$PORTNUM" -b "$BAUD" -f "$RUNTIME_DIR/autoflash_probe.bin@0-1000"
177: else
178:   echo "=== 开始烧录（无需按 RST）==="
179:   set -- download -p "$PORTNUM" -b "$BAUD" -s 0 -i "$IMAGE"
180: fi
181: 
182: # Output goes to the terminal *and* the log.
183: #
184: # bk_loader draws its erase/write progress with cli_printf_progress_bar,
185: # which emits "Erasing Flash ... 42%\r" -- carriage return, no newline.  Two
186: # things are needed to see that live: tee, so the bytes reach the terminal at
187: # all, and stdbuf -o0, because with a pipe on stdout glibc would otherwise
188: # block-buffer 4 KB at a time and the bar would arrive in lurches.
189: #
190: # The PID is stashed in a file because with a pipeline $! would be tee's.
191: (
192:   stdbuf -o0 -e0 timeout "$OVERALL_TIMEOUT" "$LOADER" "$@" &
193:   echo $! > "$PIDFILE"
194:   wait $!
195: ) 2>&1 | tee "$LOG" &
196: PIPELINE_PID=$!
197: 
198: LOADER_PID=""
199: for _ in $(seq 1 50); do
200:   if [ -s "$PIDFILE" ]; then LOADER_PID=$(cat "$PIDFILE"); break; fi
201:   sleep 0.1
202: done
203: [ -n "$LOADER_PID" ] || die "无法获取 bk_loader 进程号"
204: 
205: # Wait for it to actually enter the retry loop before poking the board.
206: for _ in $(seq 1 40); do
207:   grep -q "Getting Bus" "$LOG" && break
208:   kill -0 "$LOADER_PID" 2>/dev/null || break
209:   sleep 0.1
210: done
211: 
212: if ! kill -0 "$LOADER_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
213:   echo "  bk_loader 提前退出:"
214:   tail -5 "$LOG" | sed 's/^/    | /'
215:   wait "$LOADER_PID"; exit 1
216: fi
217: 
218: GOT_BUS=0
219: 
220: echo "  bk_loader 已进入握手循环，开始发送软复位"
221: 
222: for i in $(seq 1 "$REBOOT_TRIES"); do
223:   if grep -aq "Gotten Bus" "$LOG"; then GOT_BUS=1; break; fi
224:   kill -0 "$LOADER_PID" 2>/dev/null || break
225: 
226:   # If the console happens to be bridged to the AP shell, escape back to the
227:   # CP shell first: Ctrl-] then '.'.
228:   #
229:   # The trailing newline after the escape is essential.  Without it the CP
230:   # shell buffers all of it as a single line and sees "\x1d.reboot", answers
231:   # "cmd NOT found: .reboot" and never resets -- which made every attempt here
232:   # fall through to the manual RST prompt.  Measured: with the flush the board
233:   # reboots, without it it never does.
234:   printf '\035' > "$PORT" 2>/dev/null
235:   printf '.'    > "$PORT" 2>/dev/null
236:   printf '\r\n' > "$PORT" 2>/dev/null
237:   printf 'reboot\r\n' > "$PORT" 2>/dev/null
238:   echo "  第 $i 次软复位已发出"
239: 
240:   # Poll frequently so we stop writing the instant the bus is taken --
241:   # further bytes would corrupt the download protocol.
242:   for _ in $(seq 1 15); do
243:     if grep -q "Gotten Bus" "$LOG"; then GOT_BUS=1; break; fi
244:     sleep 0.1
245:   done
246:   [ "$GOT_BUS" -eq 1 ] && break
247: done
248: 
249: if [ "$GOT_BUS" -eq 1 ]; then
250:   echo "  握手成功，下面是 bk_loader 的实时输出："
251: else
252:   echo "  软复位没能拿到总线 —— 现在请手动按一次 RST（按一下就彻底松手）"
253:   echo "  bk_loader 仍在循环握手，按下去就会接上"
254: fi
255: 
256: # Waiting on the pipeline, not the loader: tee has to finish draining before
257: # the log is complete enough to judge the outcome.
258: wait "$PIPELINE_PID"
259: RC=$?
260: rm -f "$PIDFILE"
261: 
262: # ------------------------------------------------------------------ 4. 判定
263: 
264: echo
265: echo "=== 结果 ==="
266: if grep -aq "All Finished Successfully" "$LOG"; then
267:   echo "  烧录成功"
268:   grep -aE "Total Test Time|EraseFlash ->pass" "$LOG" \
269:     | tail -3 | sed 's/^/    | /'
270: else
271:   echo "  烧录失败（退出码 $RC）"
272: 
273:   # Distinguish "never got started" from "killed halfway through the write",
274:   # because the second case leaves the board unbootable and must be re-flashed
275:   # before anything else is attempted.
276:   LAST_PCT=$(tr '\r' '\n' < "$LOG" | grep -aoE "Writing Flash \.\.\. [0-9]+%" \
277:              | tail -1)
278:   if [ -n "$LAST_PCT" ]; then
279:     echo
280:     echo "  !! flash 已被擦除但只写到 $LAST_PCT —— 固件不完整，板子起不来。"
281:     echo "     必须重新完整烧录一次才能恢复。"
282:     echo "     此时固件不响应 reboot，软复位无效，需要手动按一次 RST。"
283:   elif [ "$RC" -eq 124 ]; then
284:     echo "  !! 被超时中止（上限 ${OVERALL_TIMEOUT}s）"
285:   fi
286: 
287:   echo
288:   echo "  完整日志: $LOG"
289:   exit 1
290: fi
291: 
292: # --------------------------------------------------------- 5. 可选挂回串口
293: 
294: # Put the line back to the console rate.  bk_loader left it at BAUD, and if
295: # that is not CONSOLE_BAUD then anything attaching afterwards -- screen, cat,
296: # minicom -- would see garbage and typing would do nothing.
297: if [ "$BAUD" != "$CONSOLE_BAUD" ]; then
298:   stty -F "$PORT" "$CONSOLE_BAUD" cs8 -cstopb -parenb raw -echo -crtscts \
299:     2>/dev/null
300:   echo "  串口已从 ${BAUD} 恢复为控制台的 ${CONSOLE_BAUD} baud"
301: fi
302: 
303: if [ "$ATTACH_SERIAL" -eq 1 ]; then
304:   echo
305:   command -v picocom >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "找不到 picocom"
306:   echo "=== 挂上串口（Ctrl-A Ctrl-X 退出）==="
307:   sleep 1
308:   exec picocom -b "$CONSOLE_BAUD" --flow n --parity n --databits 8 "$PORT"
309: fi
310: 
311: echo
312: echo "  接串口看日志: picocom -b $CONSOLE_BAUD --flow n --parity n --databits 8 $PORT"

**优先优化**
1. **流水线退出码目前基本不可信**

当前在[autoflash.sh](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/autoflash.sh:191)启动：

```bash
(...) 2>&1 | tee "$LOG" &
```

脚本没有启用 `pipefail`，因此[line 258](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/autoflash.sh:258)取得的 `RC` 通常是 `tee` 的退出码，而不是 `timeout/bk_loader` 的退出码。结果是：

- `bk_loader` 失败时，`RC` 仍可能为 `0`
- 超时退出码 `124` 很可能无法传到[line 283](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/autoflash.sh:283)
- 当前成功与否主要依赖日志字符串，而非进程真实状态

建议启用 `set -o pipefail`，并同时要求“退出码为 0”和日志包含成功标志。

2. **缺少 `trap`，异常退出可能遗留烧录进程**

启动 `bk_loader` 后，如果无法读取 PID、收到 `Ctrl-C`、脚本被终止或中途报错，没有统一清理：

- `timeout/bk_loader/tee` 可能继续运行
- PID 文件可能残留
- 串口可能停留在烧录波特率
- 固定日志可能继续被后台进程写入

尤其[line 203](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/autoflash.sh:203)直接 `die` 时，已经启动的后台流水线没有被处理。建议安装 `EXIT INT TERM HUP` trap，统一回收进程、删除 PID 文件并尽可能恢复控制台波特率。

3. **提前退出时等待了错误的子进程**

[line 215](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/autoflash.sh:215)执行：

```bash

```

但 `LOADER_PID` 是内部子 Shell 启动的进程，不是主 Shell 的直接子进程，主 Shell 可能报告“不是此 Shell 的子进程”。这里应该等待主 Shell 启动的 `PIPELINE_PID`，再从流水线传回真实状态。

4. **串口占用处理存在破坏性和遗漏**

当前版本[line 135](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/autoflash.sh:135)使用：

```bash

```

问题包括：

- `PORT` 会进入正则表达式，`.` 等字符具有正则含义
- 可能杀掉命令行恰好匹配的无关进程
- 当前版本不再处理 `screen` 和 `cat`
- 原始版本会遍历并关闭所有 `screen` 会话，也可能误伤与该串口无关的会话

更稳妥的做法是根据 `fuser` 返回的 PID读取 `/proc/$pid/cmdline`，只处理确定占用目标设备且属于已知串口工具的进程；对于未知进程直接报错，不自动杀死。

脚本通过 `-p` 指定实际串口路径，但 `bk_loader` 使用的是独立的 `-n` 数字：

- 软复位写入 `$PORT`
- 烧录程序接收 `$PORTNUM`

- 从 `/dev/ttyUSB<N>` 自动推导 `PORTNUM`
- 或保留 `-n`，但启动前检查两者是否一致
- 对无法推导的设备明确提示 `bk_loader` 是否支持

**可靠性改进**
6. **参数缺少校验**

[line 109](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/autoflash.sh:109)直接使用 `BAUD` 做算术。传入空值、文本、负数或 `0` 会导致算术错误或除零。应校验：

- `BAUD`、`CONSOLE_BAUD` 为正整数
- `PORTNUM` 为非负整数
- `REBOOT_TRIES` 为正整数
- 镜像可读，而不只是普通文件
- 串口可读写，并提示用户是否属于 `dialout` 组

[line 48](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/autoflash.sh:48)定义了 `REBOOT_INTERVAL=1.5`，实际重试间隔由[line 242](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/autoflash.sh:242)的 15 次 `sleep 0.1` 隐式决定。修改变量不会生效。

建议删除该变量，或者据它计算轮询次数，避免配置与行为不一致。

即使使用 `-t` 只读探测，[line 101](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/autoflash.sh:101)仍要求镜像存在，随后还计算镜像大小和 SHA256。这样在尚未完成编译时不能单独测试串口握手。

建议仅在下载模式检查镜像、大小、哈希和计算传输超时；测试模式使用单独且较短的超时时间。

9. **日志和探测文件不是并发安全的**

当前所有运行共享：

- `autoflash.log`
- `autoflash_probe.bin`

若误开两个脚本，日志会互相截断，`grep "Gotten Bus"` 也可能读取另一实例的输出。建议：

- 使用 `flock` 阻止同一串口并发烧录
- 日志使用带时间和 PID 的唯一文件名
- 可维护一个 `autoflash-latest.log` 软链接
- PID 文件恢复为运行目录内的 `mktemp`

10. **硬编码绝对工程路径降低可移植性**

[line 27](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/autoflash.sh:27)固定 `/home/mi/vela_competition`。工程移动、换用户或在其他机器运行就会失效。

当前脚本位置固定，可以根据脚本目录推导工程根目录，同时允许环境变量覆盖，例如：

```bash
SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
ROOT=${VELA_ROOT:-"$(realpath "$SCRIPT_DIR/../..")"}
```

11. **依赖命令应在启动前统一检查**

脚本依赖 `fuser`、`stty`、`stat`、`sha256sum`、`timeout`、`stdbuf`、`tee`、`grep`、`tr`，但只在 `-a` 时检查 `picocom`。缺失依赖可能在启动烧录后才失败。

建议前置执行 `command -v` 检查，并给出明确错误。

12. **固定镜像大小校验比较脆弱**

`EXPECTED_SIZE=2646016` 对当前构建很有价值，但只要分区表或打包配置合法变化，脚本就会拒绝新镜像。可以保留该保护，同时将预期大小改成：

- 命令行选项或环境变量
- 从构建产物/分区配置自动读取
- 至少在错误中说明当前固定值对应哪个固件配置

**建议实施顺序**
1. 修复 `pipefail`、退出码和错误的 `wait`
2. 增加 `trap`，确保进程、PID 文件和串口状态可清理
3. 校验 `-p/-n`、波特率和工具依赖
4. 使用 `flock`、唯一日志和 `mktemp`
5. 改进串口占用进程识别
6. 分离测试模式与烧录模式的前置检查

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Flash a BK7258 board by asking the running firmware to reboot into bootrom.
+

+  local dir=$SCRIPT_DIR
+
+  while [ "$dir" != "/" ]; do
+    if [ -x "$dir/bk_loader" ] || [ -x "$dir/tools/bk_loader" ]; then
+      printf '%s\n' "$dir"

+    fi
+    dir=$(dirname -- "$dir")
+  done

+}
+

+  if [ -x "$ROOT/bk_loader" ]; then
+    LOADER="$ROOT/bk_loader"
+  else
+    LOADER="$ROOT/tools/bk_loader"
+  fi
+fi
+
+DEFAULT_IMAGE="$ROOT/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/all-app.bin"
+RUNTIME_DIR=${AUTOFLASH_RUNTIME_DIR:-"$SCRIPT_DIR/logs/runtime"}
+EXPECTED_SIZE=${AUTOFLASH_EXPECTED_SIZE:-2646016}
+
+PORT=/dev/ttyUSB0
+PORTNUM=""
+PORTNUM_SET=0
+BAUD=115200
+CONSOLE_BAUD=115200
+IMAGE="$DEFAULT_IMAGE"
+REBOOT_TRIES=8
+ATTACH_SERIAL=0
+SKIP_SIZE_CHECK=0
+TEST_ONLY=0
+
+LOG=""
+FIFO=""
+LOADER_PID=""
+TEE_PID=""
+
+usage() {
+  cat <<'EOF'
+用法: autoflash.sh [选项]
+
+  -i <file>    要烧录的镜像，默认使用工程构建出的 all-app.bin
+  -p <port>    串口设备，默认 /dev/ttyUSB0
+  -n <num>     bk_loader 端口号；默认从 ttyUSB<num> 自动推导
+  -b <baud>    烧录波特率，默认 115200
+  -B <baud>    固件控制台波特率，默认 115200
+  -s           跳过 all-app.bin 字节数校验
+  -a           烧录成功后用 picocom 连接串口
+  -t           只测试握手，不写 flash
+  -h           显示帮助
+
+环境变量: VELA_ROOT、BK_LOADER、AUTOFLASH_RUNTIME_DIR、
+          AUTOFLASH_EXPECTED_SIZE 可覆盖自动检测的默认值。
+EOF
+}
+
+die() {
+  echo "错误: $*" >&2
+  exit 1
+}
+
+cleanup() {
+  local rc=$?
+
+  trap - EXIT INT TERM HUP
+  if [ -n "$LOADER_PID" ] && kill -0 "$LOADER_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
+    kill "$LOADER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
+    wait "$LOADER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
+  fi
+  if [ -n "$TEE_PID" ] && kill -0 "$TEE_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
+    kill "$TEE_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
+    wait "$TEE_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
+  fi
+  [ -z "$FIFO" ] || rm -f -- "$FIFO"
+  exit "$rc"
+}
+
+trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM HUP
+
+while getopts "i:p:n:b:B:sath" opt; do
+  case "$opt" in
+    i) IMAGE=$OPTARG ;;
+    p) PORT=$OPTARG ;;
+    n) PORTNUM=$OPTARG; PORTNUM_SET=1 ;;
+    b) BAUD=$OPTARG ;;
+    B) CONSOLE_BAUD=$OPTARG ;;
+    s) SKIP_SIZE_CHECK=1 ;;
+    a) ATTACH_SERIAL=1 ;;
+    t) TEST_ONLY=1 ;;
+    h) trap - EXIT INT TERM HUP; usage; exit 0 ;;
+    *) usage; exit 2 ;;
+  esac
+done
+
+case "$BAUD" in *[!0-9]*|'') die "烧录波特率必须是正整数: $BAUD" ;; esac
+case "$CONSOLE_BAUD" in *[!0-9]*|'') die "控制台波特率必须是正整数: $CONSOLE_BAUD" ;; esac
+[ "$BAUD" -gt 0 ] || die "烧录波特率必须大于 0"
+[ "$CONSOLE_BAUD" -gt 0 ] || die "控制台波特率必须大于 0"
+
+if [ "$PORTNUM_SET" -eq 0 ]; then
+  case "$PORT" in
+    /dev/ttyUSB[0-9]*) PORTNUM=${PORT#/dev/ttyUSB} ;;
+    *) die "无法从 $PORT 推导 bk_loader 端口号，请使用 -n 指定" ;;
+  esac
+fi
+case "$PORTNUM" in *[!0-9]*|'') die "bk_loader 端口号必须是非负整数: $PORTNUM" ;; esac
+
+for command_name in fuser grep mkfifo sha256sum stat stdbuf stty tee timeout tr; do
+  command -v "$command_name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "缺少命令: $command_name"
+done
+
+[ -x "$LOADER" ] || die "找不到 bk_loader: $LOADER"
+[ -c "$PORT" ] || die "串口不存在: $PORT（板子插了吗？）"
+[ -r "$PORT" ] && [ -w "$PORT" ] || die "无权读写串口: $PORT（检查 dialout 组权限）"
+mkdir -p -- "$RUNTIME_DIR" || die "无法创建运行记录目录: $RUNTIME_DIR"
+
+if [ "$TEST_ONLY" -eq 0 ]; then
+  [ -f "$IMAGE" ] && [ -r "$IMAGE" ] || die "找不到或无法读取镜像: $IMAGE"
+  SIZE=$(stat -c%s -- "$IMAGE") || die "无法读取镜像大小"
+  SHA=$(sha256sum -- "$IMAGE" | cut -d' ' -f1) || die "无法计算镜像 SHA256"
+  XFER_SECS=$(( (SIZE * 10 + BAUD - 1) / BAUD ))
+  OVERALL_TIMEOUT=$(( XFER_SECS * 2 + 60 ))
+
+  echo "=== 待烧录镜像 ==="
+  echo "  路径   : $IMAGE"
+  echo "  字节数 : $SIZE"
+  echo "  SHA256 : $SHA"
+  echo "  串口   : $PORT（bk_loader 端口 $PORTNUM）"
+  echo "  烧录   : ${BAUD} baud，传输约 ${XFER_SECS}s，超时 ${OVERALL_TIMEOUT}s"
+  echo "  控制台 : ${CONSOLE_BAUD} baud"
+
+  if [ "$SKIP_SIZE_CHECK" -eq 0 ] && [ "$(basename -- "$IMAGE")" = "all-app.bin" ]; then
+    [ "$SIZE" -eq "$EXPECTED_SIZE" ] \
+      || die "all-app.bin 应为 $EXPECTED_SIZE 字节，实际 $SIZE；用 -s 可跳过检查"
+    echo "  字节数校验通过"
+  fi
+else
+  OVERALL_TIMEOUT=40
+  echo "=== 只测试握手，不写 flash ==="
+  echo "  串口   : $PORT（bk_loader 端口 $PORTNUM）"
+  echo "  烧录   : ${BAUD} baud"
+  echo "  控制台 : ${CONSOLE_BAUD} baud"
+fi
+
+echo
+echo "=== 检查串口 ==="
+HOLDERS=$(fuser "$PORT" 2>/dev/null | tr -s ' ')
+if [ -n "$HOLDERS" ]; then
+  echo "  当前占用: $HOLDERS"
+  pkill -f "picocom.*${PORT//./\\.}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  pkill -f "minicom.*${PORT//./\\.}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  pkill -f "cat[[:space:]]+${PORT//./\\.}([[:space:]]|$)" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
+  sleep 0.5
+  HOLDERS=$(fuser "$PORT" 2>/dev/null | tr -s ' ')
+  [ -z "$HOLDERS" ] || die "串口仍被占用: $HOLDERS，请关闭对应程序后重试"
+fi
+echo "  串口空闲"
+
+stty -F "$PORT" "$CONSOLE_BAUD" cs8 -cstopb -parenb raw -echo -crtscts \
+  || die "stty 配置失败"
+
+RUN_ID=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).$$
+LOG="$RUNTIME_DIR/autoflash-$RUN_ID.log"
+FIFO="$RUNTIME_DIR/autoflash-$RUN_ID.fifo"
+mkfifo -- "$FIFO" || die "无法创建输出管道: $FIFO"
+
+if [ "$TEST_ONLY" -eq 1 ]; then
+  set -- read -p "$PORTNUM" -b "$BAUD" \
+    -f "$RUNTIME_DIR/autoflash-probe-$RUN_ID.bin@0-1000"
+else
+  set -- download -p "$PORTNUM" -b "$BAUD" -s 0 -i "$IMAGE"
+fi
+
+echo
+echo "=== 启动 bk_loader（无需手按 RST）==="

+TEE_PID=$!
+stdbuf -o0 -e0 timeout --foreground "$OVERALL_TIMEOUT" "$LOADER" "$@" > "$FIFO" 2>&1 &
+LOADER_PID=$!
+
+GETTING_BUS=0
+for _ in $(seq 1 40); do
+  if grep -aq "Getting Bus" "$LOG"; then GETTING_BUS=1; break; fi
+  kill -0 "$LOADER_PID" 2>/dev/null || break
+  sleep 0.1
+done
+
+if [ "$GETTING_BUS" -eq 0 ]; then
+  if kill -0 "$LOADER_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
+    echo "  未检测到握手提示，继续尝试软复位"
+  else
+    wait "$LOADER_PID"
+    RC=$?
+    LOADER_PID=""
+    wait "$TEE_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
+    TEE_PID=""
+    die "bk_loader 在进入握手循环前退出（退出码 $RC，日志: $LOG）"
+  fi
+else
+  echo "  bk_loader 已进入握手循环，开始发送软复位"
+fi
+
+GOT_BUS=0
+for i in $(seq 1 "$REBOOT_TRIES"); do
+  if grep -aq "Gotten Bus" "$LOG"; then GOT_BUS=1; break; fi
+  kill -0 "$LOADER_PID" 2>/dev/null || break
+
+  # Escape from the AP shell to the CP shell, flush that line, then reboot.
+  printf '\035' > "$PORT" 2>/dev/null || true
+  sleep 0.05
+  printf '.' > "$PORT" 2>/dev/null || true
+  sleep 0.05
+  printf '\r\n' > "$PORT" 2>/dev/null || true
+  sleep 0.05
+  printf 'reboot\r\n' > "$PORT" 2>/dev/null || true
+  echo "  第 $i 次软复位已发出"
+
+  for _ in $(seq 1 15); do
+    if grep -aq "Gotten Bus" "$LOG"; then GOT_BUS=1; break; fi
+    kill -0 "$LOADER_PID" 2>/dev/null || break
+    sleep 0.1
+  done
+  [ "$GOT_BUS" -eq 0 ] || break
+done
+
+if [ "$GOT_BUS" -eq 1 ]; then
+  echo "  握手成功"
+else
+  echo "  软复位未拿到总线，请手动按一次 RST；bk_loader 仍在等待"
+fi
+
+wait "$LOADER_PID"
+RC=$?
+LOADER_PID=""
+wait "$TEE_PID"
+TEE_RC=$?
+TEE_PID=""
+rm -f -- "$FIFO"
+FIFO=""
+
+echo
+echo "=== 结果 ==="
+if [ "$RC" -eq 0 ] && [ "$TEE_RC" -eq 0 ] \
+    && grep -aq "All Finished Successfully" "$LOG"; then
+  echo "  操作成功"
+  grep -aE "Total Test Time|EraseFlash ->pass" "$LOG" \
+    | tail -3 | sed 's/^/    | /'
+else
+  echo "  操作失败（bk_loader: $RC，日志输出: $TEE_RC）"
+  LAST_PCT=$(tr '\r' '\n' < "$LOG" \
+    | grep -aoE "Writing Flash \.\.\. [0-9]+%" | tail -1)
+  if [ -n "$LAST_PCT" ]; then
+    echo "  flash 已擦除但只写到 $LAST_PCT，必须重新完整烧录才能恢复"
+  elif [ "$RC" -eq 124 ]; then
+    echo "  操作被超时中止（上限 ${OVERALL_TIMEOUT}s）"
+  fi
+  echo "  完整日志: $LOG"
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+if [ "$BAUD" != "$CONSOLE_BAUD" ]; then
+  stty -F "$PORT" "$CONSOLE_BAUD" cs8 -cstopb -parenb raw -echo -crtscts \
+    2>/dev/null || true
+  echo "  串口已恢复为控制台的 ${CONSOLE_BAUD} baud"
+fi
+
+echo "  完整日志: $LOG"
+echo
+echo "Tips: 连接串口后执行软重启，可获取完整启动日志。"
+
+if [ "$ATTACH_SERIAL" -eq 1 ]; then
+  command -v picocom >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "找不到 picocom"
+  echo "=== 连接串口（Ctrl-A Ctrl-X 退出）==="
+  sleep 1
+  trap - EXIT INT TERM HUP
+  exec picocom -b "$CONSOLE_BAUD" --flow n --parity n --databits 8 "$PORT"
+fi
+
+echo "  连接命令: picocom -b $CONSOLE_BAUD --flow n --parity n --databits 8 $PORT"

是。当前脚本采用**终端实时可见，同时保存日志文件**的方式：

```bash
tee "$LOG" < "$FIFO" &
stdbuf -o0 -e0 timeout --foreground ... > "$FIFO" 2>&1 &
```

数据流是：

```text
bk_loader stdout/stderr
        ↓
      FIFO
        ↓
      tee
       ├─→ 当前 Shell 实时显示
       └─→ logs/runtime/autoflash-时间戳.PID.log
```

- `bk_loader` 的擦除、写入进度会实时显示在当前 Shell。
- 输出也会永久保存在工程内的 `logs/runtime/`，不是 `/tmp` 临时文件。
- FIFO 文件只是进程间传输通道，结束后会删除，不是日志文件。
- `-a` 只影响烧录完成后是否启动 `picocom`，不影响烧录阶段实时输出。
- `autoflash-probe-*.bin` 是 `-t` 模式读取出的探测数据，不是终端日志。

也就是说，当前实现不是“只写临时文件再读取”，而是“Shell 实时显示 + 工程目录日志留档”。
